name: Terminal Management System
definition: Terminal management system (TMS), has in charge the maintenance of the terminal, including monitoring, software update, configuration parameters management.

ContactLevel.name: Contact Level
ContactLevel.definition: Level of urgency in contacting the maintenance.

ContactDateTime.name: Contact Date Time
ContactDateTime.definition: Date and time for calling the maintenance.

AcceptorConfiguration.name: Acceptor Configuration
AcceptorConfiguration.definition: Acceptor parameters to be downloaded from the terminal management system.

NetworkAccess.name: Network Access
NetworkAccess.definition: Parameters used to access a network.

CardPaymentAcquiring.name: Card Payment Acquiring
CardPaymentAcquiring.definition: Process for which a TMS trigger is specified.

TerminalManagerRole.name: Terminal Manager Role
TerminalManagerRole.definition: Identifies the party which is the terminal manager (TM) to contact for the maintenance.

ControlledPointOfInteraction.name: Controlled Point Of Interaction
ControlledPointOfInteraction.definition: Specifies each point of interaction controlled by a TMS.

Action.name: Action
Action.definition: Terminal management action to be performed by the point of interaction.
